_description: Backtrader replay for the portfolio-allocation pipeline. The SB3 model is called live inside bt.Strategy.next(); on each bar the strategy rebuilds the (N+K, N) observation matrix used during training (covariance block + indicator rows), softmaxes the action into target weights, and rebalances via order_target_percent for every ticker.

commission._notes: type='percentage' uses bt.broker.setcommission(commission=value, percabs=True, stocklike=stocklike). type='fixed' uses absolute $ per share. Set value=0 to disable.

slippage._notes: type='percentage' -> set_slippage_perc; type='fixed' -> set_slippage_fixed; type='none' disables slippage.

broker._notes: check_submit -> bt.broker.set_checksubmit. allow_short -> bt.broker.set_shortcash; long-only matches the training env. coc (cheat-on-close) -> bt.broker.set_coc.

execution._notes: min_weight_delta suppresses target-percent rebalances when the new weight is within this absolute distance of the current portfolio weight - reduces fee churn from near-zero adjustments.

state_reconstruction._notes: use_source_indicators=true reads data.indicators from source_config - required for the state vector to match training. The covariance block is read from the cov_list column in the trade pickle (computed by 01_get_data.py).

annual_return._notes: Requires the default broker observer; conflicts with cerebro(stdstats=False). The Returns analyzer above already provides annualized return via tann=252.

pyfolio._notes: Requires pyfolio installed; emits returns/positions/transactions DataFrames.

plot._notes: Renders a clean strategy-level equity curve via matplotlib. Cerebro's default plot is not used because it produces one subplot per data feed (27 subplots for a portfolio strategy). overlay_djia rescales source_config.baselines.dji_ticker to the strategy's starting equity and dashes it on the same axes.
